question.text: If the highest frequency modulating a carrier is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kHz</mi></math>, then the number of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mi>M</mi></math> broadcast stations accommodated in a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>90</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kHz</mi></math> bandwidth are

solution.text:
B. W. (Bandwidth) =2× maximum frequency at modulating signal

=2×5 kHz

=10 kHz

∴ No of stations accommodate =9010=9
